Marisol next, do as you're told

It's for the fishing, that's all
Cold on the dock through my shoes
It's for the fishing, that's all
Light comes up the bayou like syrup

Chairs first, before the valley fills with light

River's just doing what rivers do

Sun's on the far bank already

First light on the outer reef. Done.

Sworn in by these two cold hands
Sun on the counter as witness
Bus at eight. The republic is this.

Quick, to the window before the light moves
